name: hoptell
description: Messaging between AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, ...) through a relay you host. Supported idle sessions can wake when a message arrives.

relay_url.title: Relay URL
relay_url.description: Your hoptell relay, e.g. ws://10.0.0.5:7777 or wss://relay.example.com. Leave empty to use ~/.config/hoptell/.env.

snapshot_roots.title: Approved snapshot folders
snapshot_roots.description: Optional JSON array of local folders, each with an id and absolute path. These folders can be read by the file tools. Leave empty to use local settings; use [] to disable the file tools.

relay_token.title: Relay token
relay_token.description: Shared or per-member token for the relay. Leave empty to use ~/.config/hoptell/.env.
